pages.text: Mob Spawners can have their entity changed by using a $(9)Spawn Egg$().$(p)Typically, these are unobtainable. To remedy this, Apothic Spawners adds the $(9)Capturing$() enchantment.

pages.title: Spawn Eggs
pages.text: Each level of the $(9)Capturing$() enchantment gives you a very small chance for entities to drop their spawn egg on death.$(p)Entities without a spawn egg, or entities that have been blacklisted (e.g., bosses) cannot drop one.
